title: Aspirations in Medicine and Healthcare Initiatives (AiM HI)
description: One-day hands-on healthcare career exploration experience for students in grades 10-12. Northeast Region events are hosted annually in March at Wilkes University in Wilkes-Barre.
date_display: March 2027 (annual Northeast Region event; exact date not posted)
eligibility: Grades 10-12. Participation is coordinated through local school districts; students register through a school or career counselor.

title: Junior Volunteer Program
description: Structured summer service and healthcare-career exploration program combining volunteer service with interactive educational sessions at Geisinger sites including Scranton and Wilkes-Barre.
date_display: Summer 2027 (annual program; 2027 application dates not posted)
eligibility: High school students ages 15-18. The 2026 cycle required an application, references, essay, interview, orientation, 40 service hours, and 15 educational hours. 2027 dates and requirements should be confirmed when posted.

title: Nursing and Health Sciences Scholars Program
description: Healthcare workforce scholarship pathway providing up to $40,000 in financial support for eligible students pursuing selected health careers, with a post-education work commitment to Geisinger.
date_display: Current pathway; application timing not listed
eligibility: Available for students pursuing RN, LPN, Certified Medical Assistant, Respiratory Therapist, or Surgical Technologist pathways. A work commitment with Geisinger is required after education.

title: NE PA AHEC Rural Health Scholarship
organization: Northeast Pennsylvania Area Health Education Center
description: $2,000 scholarship for high school seniors from Northeast Pennsylvania who plan to attend a two-year allied-health program at a college in the region.
eligibility: High school seniors from Bradford, Lackawanna, Luzerne, Monroe, Pike, Sullivan, Susquehanna, Wayne, or Wyoming counties planning to attend a two-year allied-health program in the region.

title: EXPLOR-NEPA: AI, Robotics and Career Pathway
description: Free Northeast Pennsylvania pathway for Wilkes-Barre Area and Hazleton Area high school students in grades 9-12, with robotics, AI, industry exposure, dual-enrollment opportunities, stipends, and scholarships.
eligibility: Open to Wilkes-Barre Area and Hazleton Area high school students in grades 9-12. No prior robotics or AI experience is required.

title: Anatomage Tournament
description: Team-based anatomy competition for high school, CTC, and CTE students using 3D Anatomage technology, with workshops, healthcare career exposure, and scholarships for top teams.
eligibility: High school, CTC, and CTE school teams of three or four students.

title: UPMC Hillman Cancer Center Academy
description: Free 7-8 week summer research program for high school students, primarily rising juniors and seniors, with hands-on cancer research, mentorship, career preparation, and a final research presentation.
eligibility: High school students meeting the age requirements. Housing is not provided.

title: PASH Saturday Academy
organization: University of Pennsylvania Perelman School of Medicine
description: Four-Saturday research and dermatology academy for Philadelphia public and charter high-school students, with a pathway to apply for summer research internships.
audiences: Philadelphia Public and Charter School Students
eligibility: Sophomores, juniors, and seniors attending Philadelphia public or charter high schools. No prior research experience is required. Application opens October 2026 and closes January 2027.

title: PHILA Public Health Pre-College Program
organization: Drexel University Dornsife School of Public Health
description: One-week July pre-college program for high school juniors and seniors exploring public health, advocacy, policy, health administration, prevention, environment, and epidemiology.
date_display: Summer 2027; one week in July (exact dates not posted)
eligibility: High school juniors and seniors. Students must commute to Drexel's Dornsife School of Public Health; 2027 registration information is expected in spring 2027.

title: Pennsylvania Hospital Junior Volunteer Program
description: Summer junior-volunteer experience for ages 14-17 that provides behind-the-scenes exposure to healthcare professions.
eligibility: Students ages 14-17. Penn Medicine states applications for Summer 2027 may begin February 1, 2027.

title: Provost's Summer Mentorship Program
description: Four-week summer college and career preparatory program for Philadelphia rising 10th and 11th graders, with career exploration through Penn professional-school partners including medicine, nursing, engineering, law, and dentistry.
eligibility: Students currently in 9th or 10th grade who attend a Philadelphia high school and have at least a 3.0 GPA. The 2027 application cycle begins in January 2027.
